definitions.gloss: everywhere; all over the place; wherever you go
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something exists or occurs in every location or in many different places.

examples.japanese: {至|いた}る{所|ところ}にゴミが{落|お}ちている。
{春|はる}になると{至|いた}る{所|ところ}で{桜|さくら}が{咲|さ}く。
examples.english: When spring comes, cherry blossoms bloom everywhere.

examples.japanese: この{街|まち}では{至|いた}る{所|ところ}に{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}が{設置|せっち}されている。
examples.english: Vending machines are installed everywhere in this city.

notes:
{至|いた}る{所|ところ} means "everywhere" or "all over." Literally "the place one arrives at" — i.e., wherever you go.

USAGE:
Functions as a noun, typically followed by に or で. Can also be written {至|いた}るところ (hiragana for ところ). Slightly more literary than どこにでも.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {至|いた}る{所|ところ}にある: to be everywhere
- {至|いた}る{所|ところ}で{見|み}かける: to see in many places
- {至|いた}る{所|ところ}に{広|ひろ}がる: to spread everywhere

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どこにでも: everywhere (casual)
- あちこち: here and there (scattered)
- {至|いた}る{所|ところ}: everywhere (slightly formal, emphatic)
